invariants.statement: apps/web is required and must be built from this repository's source; the desktop client must package that local build.
Desktop packaging must not download a prebuilt web bundle or depend on an upstream release key.
Seventwos UI, product, auth, storage, profile migration, configuration, and release paths require repository ownership review.
Upstream assessment automation may report candidates but may not apply changes, merge, or publish.
Existing upstream ledger entries may not be edited, reordered, or removed.
